Normalized whitespace mode collapses multiple spaces

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Text   with    extra   spaces.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(whitespace_mode: 'Normalized'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
